method: Read distributed INI/Papyrus scripts and analyze supplied DLL with matching PDB symbols in Ghidra. Decompiled output is evidence of the compiled implementation, not original C++ source.
observations: updateRoot derives separate hand angular hints relative to a pelvis-based reference, limits the hints about HMD yaw, and combines the two hints with HMD yaw using angleWeightedAverage.

HMD weighting increases with root-to-head angular discrepancy. Hand weights depend on player arm-length fields relative to configured arm scale/length; the upstream exact definition of those arm-length fields was not traced.
bodyRotationAngleLimit defaults to 6 degrees. The compiled unlock decision also considers player speed and input weights; 6 degrees alone is not the full algorithm.

When rotation is unlocked and ordinary nonseated behavior applies, updateRoot moves current root yaw toward the estimated target using frameTime * 5 times angular error, then can lock again within the configured angle limit.
The routine stores half the estimated target-to-root angular error as m_playerSpineTwist and transforms stored foot positions/rotations when changing the root.
INI smoothAmount and smoothStopMultiplier describe vertical movement smoothing, not this root yaw update.
The inspected root routine estimates facing rather than directly measuring whether real feet moved.
comparison: TR RoomscaleHeadingRecovery derives absolute facing primarily from the inter-controller line and recent-motion windows. VRIK uses separate body-relative hand hints and a persistent rotation lock.
TR already has independent rotation-compensated walking evidence and stable root/foot pivot handling; retain those while evaluating a new facing estimator.

Potential next experiment: body-relative weighted facing with geometric lock/unlock and time-based convergence. Preserve TR's stronger fixed-controller glance constraint; VRIK's HMD weighting could otherwise turn the body on large head-only glances.
Do not transplant camera height, body size or vertical bobbing settings; those are separate from the current task.
